ValidationRule.description: Requires that AGP checklist fields on the opportunity be populated before moving state to Closed Won - State Farm AGP
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name= "Accelerated-State Farm"&& ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")&& OR( ISPICKVAL( X5k_spend_3k_for_State_Farm__c ,"" ), ISPICKVAL( Ability_to_provide_data_feedback__c ,"" ), ISPICKVAL( Agreed_to_no_lead_returns__c , ""), ISPICKVAL( At_least_2_lead_types__c , ""), ISPICKVAL( Currently_has_Lead_Management_System__c , ""), ISPICKVAL( Geo_At_least_1_MSA_covered__c , ""), ISPICKVAL( Hours_of_Delivery_24_7_or_24_5__c , ""), ISPICKVAL( Minimum_Agency_Size_of_3__c , ""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: One or more AGP checklist fields are not populated on this opportunity. Please update the fields.
